tasks.BusTravelFromMToN: Calculate the number of ways to travel from M to N using 3 buses.
tasks.BusTravelFromNToO: Calculate the number of ways to travel from N to O using 4 buses.
tasks.BusTravelFromPOToQ: Calculate the number of ways to travel from P to Q using 3 buses.
tasks.TotalWaysCalculation: Multiply the results from previous tasks to get the total number of ways to travel from M to Q.
